definitions.name: G1A.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value, element-wise over a Vector

definitions.name: G1A.MAD
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V G0A.MEDIAN SUB G1A.ABS G0A.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: G1A.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers of a Vector (length >= 3)

definitions.name: G1A.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: G1A.MODE
definitions.note: most frequent element of a Vector; smallest on ties

definitions.name: G1A.TRIMMED
definitions.note: mean after removing one smallest and one largest number

definitions.name: G1A.LONGEST
definitions.body: 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: longest String in a Vector of Strings; first on ties

definitions.name: G1A.CAPWORD
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: a non-empty String with its first character upper-cased

definitions.name: G1A.CAPITALIZE
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of every space-separated word

definitions.name: G1A.INITIALS
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case initials of words longer than three letters ('' if none)

definitions.name: G1A.AMOUNTS
definitions.note: amounts column of a Vector of [ name amount ] entries

definitions.name: G1A.NAMES
definitions.note: names column of a Vector of [ name amount ] entries

definitions.name: G1A.KEYSWHERE
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: keys of a Record whose numeric value is below zero, in key order

definitions.name: G1A.LARGEST
definitions.body: 'E' BIND E E G1A.AMOUNTS G0A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: [ name amount ] entry with the largest amount; first on ties
